### 2026-10-27: I just had an amazing idea

**0.5h**

I just had an amazing idea

This morning I was trying to figure out how to budget everything in. Along with that how it would be done. Then I randomly thought, could i measure the tempature of the window to calculate the outdoor temp? Turns out you can, this simplifies the use of the tempature sensor greatly. I can't wait to get to work on the project this afternoon.

Thanks for reading!

### 2026-10-28: no school

**4.1h**

no school

I was sick so I stayed home from school, which gave me plenty of time to work on the project. First of all I exported all of the files for the PCB and put them into the github. After that I also got a 3d model of the pcb, which I used for the 3D Modeling. I started work on a case for the project but I realized that before completely going at the model I would need to test what I have. Apparently my school has a 3d printer anyone can use for free so I will be printing the model of the pcb and its case. I'll use them to roughly test how the pcb will fit. Its going to be a press fit.

Thanks for reading.
